children: APA Corp said its board approved a further 40 million shares to buy back.
The company, which owns units that explore for and produce oil and natural gas, had 352.9 million shares outstanding.
Shares closed at $44.79 on Wednesday, down 5.5%, before recently ticking up to $44.93 in after-hours trading.
The board also approved a regular quarterly dividend of 25 cents a share, payable Nov. 23 to shareholders of record on Oct. 22.
